name: Gasthaus Widauer
kurzbeschreibung:
**Welcome to Gasthaus Widauer in Ellmau**

Nestled in the heart of the **Tiroler Alps**, **Gasthaus Widauer** in **Ellmau** invites you to experience authentic **Tirolian** hospitality in a cozy mountain atmosphere. Just a short drive from **Innsbruck**, this charming guesthouse offers warm rooms, hearty **Tirolian** cuisine, and breathtaking views of the surrounding peaks.

Indulge in traditional dishes like **Kaiserschmarrn**, **Tiroler Gröstl**, or a comforting bowl of **Käsespätzle**, all prepared with local ingredients. After a day of hiking, skiing, or exploring the **Zillertal Valley**, unwind with a glass of **Tiroler Apfelstrudel** or a steaming mug of **Tirolian coffee**.

Whether you're seeking relaxation or adventure, **Gasthaus Widauer** is your perfect retreat in the **Tirolian** countryside. **Willkommen im Zillertal!**
